description: Labelled NL-to-SQL questions for the ai-data-studio retail demo database (PostgreSQL, demo/init). Reference queries define the expected result; generated SQL passes when it returns the same rows (row and column order ignored, numbers to two decimals). Revenue excludes cancelled orders, as the analytics views do.

cases.question: How many orders were placed in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: select count(*) from sales.orders where order_date >= date '2025-01-01' and order_date < date '2026-01-01'

cases.question: How many orders are there per status?
cases.reference_sql: select status, count(*) from sales.orders group by status

cases.question: Total revenue in 2025, excluding cancelled orders
cases.reference_sql: select sum(total_amount) from sales.orders where status <> 'cancelled' and order_date >= date '2025-01-01' and order_date < date '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Revenue by customer segment in 2025, excluding cancelled orders
cases.reference_sql: select c.segment, sum(o.total_amount) from sales.orders o join sales.customers c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id where o.status <> 'cancelled' and o.order_date >= date '2025-01-01' and o.order_date < date '2026-01-01' group by c.segment

cases.question: Number of orders per sales channel
cases.reference_sql: select channel, count(*) from sales.orders group by channel

cases.question: Top 5 products by units sold, excluding cancelled orders, with their units
cases.reference_sql: select p.name, sum(oi.quantity) from sales.order_items oi join sales.orders o on o.order_id = oi.order_id join catalog.products p on p.product_id = oi.product_id where o.status <> 'cancelled' group by p.product_id, p.name order by 2 desc limit 5

cases.question: How many customers are in each country?
cases.reference_sql: select country, count(*) from sales.customers group by country

cases.question: Average order value per channel, excluding cancelled orders
cases.reference_sql: select channel, avg(total_amount) from sales.orders where status <> 'cancelled' group by channel

cases.question: How many active employees are in each department?
cases.reference_sql: select d.name, count(*) from hr.employees e join hr.departments d on d.department_id = e.department_id where e.termination_date is null group by d.name

cases.question: Total refund amount per return reason
cases.reference_sql: select reason, sum(refund_amount) from sales.returns group by reason

cases.question: How many invoices are overdue?
cases.reference_sql: select count(*) from finance.invoices where status = 'overdue'

cases.question: Total expenses per department in 2025
cases.reference_sql: select d.name, sum(x.amount) from finance.expenses x join hr.departments d on d.department_id = x.department_id where x.incurred_on >= date '2025-01-01' and x.incurred_on < date '2026-01-01' group by d.name

cases.question: How many products are in each category?
cases.reference_sql: select c.name, count(*) from catalog.products p join catalog.categories c on c.category_id = p.category_id group by c.name

cases.question: Which payment methods were used, and how many payments each?
cases.reference_sql: select method, count(*) from sales.payments group by method
